title: Freight Partner Terms: Booking Fee for Repeat Redeliveries on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For a rebooked redelivery of a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase shipped by Large Item Freight Delivery, the booking fee depends on the redelivery fees already charged on the order.

| Redelivery fees already charged on the order | Booking fee |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $69.00 |
| Exactly one | $59.00 |
| None | Not raised by these terms |

### Reading the terms

- The count is of redelivery fee entries on the order history - the fees of kind redelivery charged on that order - and not of delivery attempts.
- Exactly one prior redelivery fee sets the booking fee at $59.00; a second or any later one sets it at $69.00.

### Examples (hypothetical orders)

| Order history | Booking fee |
|---|---|
| Freight fee only, no redelivery fee | Not raised by these terms |
| Freight fee and one redelivery fee | $59.00 |
| Freight fee and two redelivery fees | $69.00 |
| Freight fee and three redelivery fees | $69.00 |
